fields.description: Byte 0 of the 8-byte save payload block at save offset 0x266C. Whole block is loaded from SRAM into a RAM mirror and covered by a CRC32 integrity word.

fields.description: Stored CRC32 (little-endian) of the 8 payload bytes at 0x266C..0x2674. Verified: CRC32 of 8 zero bytes is 0x6522DF69, matching the stored bytes 69 DF 22 65. Kept as a u32 field because CRC32 is not in the Schema v2 checksum algorithm list.
fields.evidence: FUN_08018ca8 reads the 4-byte stored word via FUN_08001420 (_DAT_08018cdc) and compares it against FUN_080013c0 CRC32 over 8 bytes; FUN_08018c6c shows the same stored-word-read pattern (_DAT_08018c84). Stored value at save offset 0x2674 verified byte-exact against samples/baseline.sav in Python.
fields.name: stored_crc32
